paragraphs: Here's what I want you to take from Amos 3, friend. The LORD says to Israel, "Only you have I known from all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities." (Amos 3:2) Being close to God doesn't make you exempt. It means He speaks to you straight, because He knows you.

Then Amos asks question after question, and every one of them says the same thing: things have causes. A lion doesn't roar for nothing, and a trap doesn't spring with nothing to catch (Amos 3:4-5). So when the LORD speaks, there's a reason. The people were storing up "violence and destruction in their citadels" (Amos 3:10), and the warning didn't come out of nowhere.

And look at how He does it. "Surely the Lord GOD does nothing without revealing His plan to His servants the prophets." (Amos 3:7) He warns before the trouble comes, because He wants to be heard. So when God's Word shakes you a little, baker, don't hit snooze. Listen, and get your heart ready, because the lion has roared and the LORD is still talking.
